suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

before_times: the kind of visit (new consult, monitoring, procedure day, injection teaching at home)
whether it's a video consult (counts as at the clinic)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a procedure day: the adult who will drive the patient home, named on the booking
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
after_time: a note for the clinician: a past faint at a visit, or a hard blood draw
for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code
secure_page_only: the private history for a new patient (on the secure page only)
date of birth (every visit is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter, only where the clinic asks
consent for a procedure, signed before the day
a partner's OK to join, on the secure page
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves (18 or older); a partner may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page; nobody under 18 is booked; donor and surrogacy matching is never booked by Rosie

stop.words: heavy bleeding, severe belly or pelvic pain, dizziness or fainting, trouble breathing, or chest pain, after a procedure or a stimulation medicine

go_on.words: mild cramping or bloating after a procedure
go_on.what: the booking goes on, with the soonest same-day time; the nurse line calls within the hour; never answered by Rosie

go_on.words: a question about a medicine or a result
go_on.what: never answered by Rosie: the clinic's nurse line; the clinician is told that day

go_on.words: feels unsafe at home or with a partner
go_on.what: the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: A private history for a new patient
steps.when: on the secure page before the first consult
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the consult waits

steps.name: Consent for a procedure
steps.when: signed on the secure page before the procedure day
steps.result: signed: booked; not signed: no procedure day

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: The procedure day's companion
steps.when: named on the booking, before the day
steps.result: named: booked; none: no procedure day

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: photo ID, the plan card, a list of medicines, and any old records; for a procedure day: the companion's name and a plan for the ride home; for a home visit, clear the path to the room

staff.skills: reproductive medicine, monitoring, IUI and retrieval support, embryology, semen analysis, injection teaching, counseling referral, Spanish
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each doctor holds a state physician license; each nurse holds a nursing license; the clinic keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
staff.supervision: the clinic's medical director; a new nurse or clinician works under a senior one until signed off
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs new patients, procedure prices and refunds
staff.stand_in: a patient may ask for a named doctor; the next open clinician with the skill takes it otherwise; a procedure day stays with its named team, and is never moved to a stand-in without the patient's OK

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves (18 or older); a partner may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page; nobody under 18 is booked; donor and surrogacy matching is never booked by Rosie
children_and_age.minors_texts: no patient under 18: nobody under 18 is booked

visit.check_in: at the front desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
visit.done: the code, then DONE from the clinician; the bill is the clinic's; results go to the patient's secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
visit.changes_at_visit: the clinic adds a test or a monitoring visit: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; a procedure day waits for a written OK; nothing else is sold at a visit

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: a state physician license for each reproductive doctor, and the clinic's license where the state requires one; a nurse's license for injection teaching; the lab's certificate for any semen analysis the state names; the clinic's registration where the state's rules require it
license.who: both: the clinic, and each clinician or nurse who sees patients
license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number and the clinic's registration; nothing is needed to book
license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
license.background: the clinic's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them

never_in_a_text: the history, the names of tests or procedures, cycle or pregnancy details, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the clinic's name, the day, the time and the place
